operator_observation: User confirmed that the TPU pads slid during this pull.
restraint_method: Hand-held on other faces; operator reports holding the cube stationary, as in retry4.
interpretation: Initial approximately 24.84 N axial preload unloaded, then opposing load built to 8.17 N and weakened during further sliding. The loading peak later fell by over 40 percent, sustained for the detector hold interval, triggering a normal stop at 7.17 mm. Observed sliding agrees with the force-drop candidate, but its onset was not timestamped.
useful_for: Force-versus-travel calibration for effective TPU pad bending and sliding at raw speed 0 / force 0 on the 60 mm cube. Preserve the weakening along travel rather than fitting only one force scalar.
limitation: The video supports bending and sliding with the cube held against the table, but hand/cube motion is not measured precisely. Video and RTDE lack shared synchronization, and the first microscopic slip cannot be timestamped reliably. The later force-drop trigger does not establish static breakaway. Wrist load does not separately measure opposing normal finger squeeze or friction coefficient.
